title: Feature request: option to sync / import temp basals from Nightscout
symptom: There appear to be options for syncing basically everything else (including boluses and profile-default basals!) from Nightscout, and those work great, but I can't see any way to get AAPS to import temp basals. This would be super useful when switching to a new phone, because you could get everything (almost) perfectly lined up on the new phone, using virtual pump with the loop disabled, and then switch over while still having accurate IoB.
fix: Syncing TBRs is dangerous. You can do it in engineering mode.
